d1_first_principles.model_interface_explanation: D1 ATLIF emits exactly 0 or a learned scalar theta, while D0/D2/D3 emit exactly 0 or 1. A one-bit support mask alone therefore omits an amplitude semantic.

folded_weight_route.reason: Moving theta from every FP32 source value into the weights changes multiplication rounding and accumulation bit patterns; real-arithmetic distributivity is insufficient for FP32 bit equivalence.

original_weight_output_scale_route.reason: Output scaling changes rounding position relative to the original per-source theta multiplication and accumulation.

value_preserving_route.definition: Reconstruct each active source as the exact FP32 theta and multiply by the original FP32 weight in the frozen arithmetic order.
value_preserving_route.conditional_repairability: YES at the payload/interface boundary; NO as a currently admitted accelerated same-resource compute path.

lineage_diagnosis.M624: Historical availability audit before M686: zero ConvTranspose rows and absent decoder bitpacks/deployment weights. M686 later resolved activation payloads and original FP32 weights, but did not create the missing admitted INT8/fixed-point decoder bridge or a co-executable full-system schema. M624 must not be reused as proof that D1 lacks a captured input.
lineage_diagnosis.M686_M692: Forty sealed records and all four original FP32 weights exist. D1 input is exact scaled-binary for all ten samples, but both folded-weight deployment and original-weight/output-scale deployment are unadmitted.
lineage_diagnosis.M700_M739: Official Prosperity maps D0/D2/D3 as a 30-record exact binary-support subset. D1 is a separate ten-record opportunity diagnostic because numerical folded-weight equivalence failed.
lineage_diagnosis.M785: The same-resource scheduler accepts every D1 record but bypasses sparse mapping into a common full-shape dense-FP32 billing stream for all configurations. It retains D1 cost but does not prove an executable Acc24/INT8 numeric implementation.
lineage_diagnosis.M809_M836: The production orchestration retains D1 cycles and excludes D1 from headline totals. The only final replay failed with return code 143, so there is no canonical production cycle result. This runner/result gap is independent of D1 numerical non-equivalence.
lineage_diagnosis.M896_M925_M939: M896 changes scheduler storage only. Its real workload selector is hard-coded to records[0], D0/sample0/A1/t0. M925/M939 therefore prove one D0 scheduler row and contain no D1 repair or four-layer coverage.

external_opportunity_boundary.allowed_location: External Table-C opportunity and motivation only

recommended_minimum_slice.required_implementation_change: Add a fresh row selector and source-only bounded-prefix path around frozen M785/M896 semantics; do not alter the mapper, resource or cycle priorities in the first slice.
recommended_minimum_slice.valid_claim: D0/D2/D3 exact-binary support subset plus separately charged D1 diagnostic

runtime_budget_and_stop_gates.stage_zero: Run only 1K/10K/100K prefixes for D1/D2/D3 under fresh identities and project contributor-state, scheduler-state, elapsed and RSS before any full row.
stop_if: Any D1 reconstructed input hash differs from the sealed raw-input SHA; currently 0/10 differ.
Any proposal reuses folded-theta weights as lossless; the route is permanently nonexact for the frozen FP32 checkpoint.
Projected peak RSS plus a two-times safety margin exceeds available memory or commit headroom.
Projected full-row time exceeds a freshly derived bounded timeout; the D0-specific 2715-second release must not be reused for D2/D3.
A D2/D3 source path changes transaction ordering, resource timing, or address/commit hashes before a bounded exact miter passes.
A D1 scale-aware path requires a separate FP32 datapath or changes the Acc24/INT8 resource without a new fair baseline and physical accounting.
Any aggregate is labeled decoder-complete before D1 numeric equivalence and all four same-resource rows are independently sealed.
runtime_budget_and_stop_gates.recommended_scalability_repair_if_d3_pre: Stream contributors by destination/stripe before M896 rather than materializing the full destination-to-contributor dictionary; exact-miter the new stream against frozen M785 on bounded prefixes before a full row.

d1_exact_repair_options.name: SCALE_AWARE_SOURCE_DESCRIPTOR_WITH_ORIGINAL_WEIGHT
d1_exact_repair_options.conditional_go: Only if the existing value field and arithmetic lane can preserve the chosen numeric contract without an unfair extra datapath.

d1_exact_repair_options.name: NEW_BINARY_D1_DEPLOYMENT_CHECKPOINT
d1_exact_repair_options.method: Make D1 emitted amplitude exactly one or power-of-two, then PAFT/fine-tune and recapture.

paper_boundary.headline_wording: Exact-binary D0/D2/D3 decoder support subset under the common resource; D1 is charged separately as a nonheadline dense diagnostic.
